title: Sharing Validation
description: Validates content for sharing and marketplace requirements. Identifies custom capabilities and potentially problematic content that may affect distribution.

100.title: Custom Capabilities
100.description: Information about custom capabilities the pack requires (experiments, Beta APIs, etc.). Some capabilities may limit where content can be shared.
100.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the name of the custom capability required

101.title: Strong Language
101.description: Warning when content may contain strong language.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the text or location where strong language was detected
